project_name: Jaipur Home — First Floor Interior Design Delivery

approved_baseline.authority: Historical design starting point and protected decisions. The same output/jaipur-home folder is now the Git-tracked working model.
approved_baseline.note: Single model. Includes R-006, R-007, R-010, R-011 and (27 Oct 2026) R-008 realism + R-012 master bathroom. All drafts and numbered copies retired. R-013, R-014 and R-015 (open master shower, 1 mm floor joints) applied directly. R-016 QA fixes applied. R-017 (28 Oct 2026) smoother movement, render quality unchanged. R-018 bathroom wall tile to ceiling. R-019 kitchen-living ledge integrated on 28 Oct 2026: set back near sofa, wall-abutting, kitchen-side drawers; site fit pending. R-020 kitchen worktop granite study rendered from the client photo on both runs; material selection pending.

source_hierarchy: Architect layout PDF and parsed geometry
Current maintained model, README, CHANGELOG, handoff and Git history
Explicitly approved room packages and elevation references
Historical chats, inspiration and older versions as evidence only
protected_decisions: Constructed walls, columns, rooms, openings, stair, lift well and ventilation shafts are not changed without explicit user request and professional sign-off.
The 10 ft model ceiling remains the current baseline assumption.
Approved kitchen cabinet/elevation logic remains protected.
Kitchen dining set/pendants and separate living-to-kitchen handwash remain removed.
Living hall retains 75 in TV, compact perpendicular puja, continuous L-sofa principle and current TV/W5 relationship.
Bedroom 2 privacy screen remains rejected; shifted bed group is the current baseline.

session_policy.default_retrieval: Use the boot pack and request-relevant artifacts only.
session_policy.historical_chat_retrieval: Use only when state and approved artifacts do not answer the request.
force_baseline_reread_when: A source hash differs from artifact-manifest.json
The request changes constructed geometry or a protected decision
The request is safety-critical or execution-sensitive
Independent QA or a significant model geometry update is requested

model_routing.rule: Every specialist launch must resolve to an explicit model and reasoning effort; inherited/default model launches are blocked.
model_routing.premium_rule: Premium tier or high-and-above reasoning requires a separate approved, single-use consent record for each specialist launch.
model_routing.runtime_availability_rule: An unavailable or unknown selected model blocks the launch; there is no silent fallback.

update_rule: Update with each coherent Git-tracked model or control-state change; preserve source hierarchy and site holds.

workflow.change_record: Git commit per coherent update, with current README/changelog and checks kept in sync
workflow.draft_policy: No routine per-revision 3D draft folder or promotion gate; make a separate review artifact only when requested or needed for a decision.
workflow.site_hold: Git changes remain concept/coordination work until measured and professionally detailed where required.

maintained_model.change_tracking: Git commits; no routine per-revision 3D draft folder
maintained_model.current_change: R-019 kitchen-living ledge and R-020 kitchen granite study integrated; site fit and stone selection pending
